baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثَالِثُ ثَلَاثَةٍ is directly corrected by إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinal image makes Allah a member who completes a counted set, while the unity branch denies partner, partition, and multiplication. The correction therefore rejects divine componenthood, not merely an incorrect total.

activation_trace.role: The third-as-completer image supplies the positional mechanism of adding one member to two.
Unity without partner, division, or multiplication supplies the direct negation of membered deity.
The worshipped-deity image fixes the disputed count to the category of worship, rather than to three unrelated entities.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply replaces the number three with the number one.
changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects placing Allah as a member or part inside any counted divine composite; the one deity is without partner or partition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالُوا and يَقُولُونَ frame the proposition, while كَفَرَ and كَفَرُوا repeat the diagnosis.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying branch can denote an adopted doctrine, and the disbelief branch can denote covering truth. Repetition turns a single utterance into a maintained verbal creed whose continued circulation performs the covering.

activation_trace.role: Saying as belief or school supplies the durable doctrinal stance behind both the initial and continuing speech.
Covering the truth supplies the functional effect assigned to the maintained proposition.
Cessation supplies a possible break in the mechanism, showing that persistence rather than bare historical utterance is at issue.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports and condemns one erroneous sentence.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a repeatedly maintained creed that covers unitary worship, while making cessation from that verbal practice a live possibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional لَمْ يَنتَهُوا is followed by the emphatic لَيَمَسَّنَّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch marks an endpoint at which motion stops; the other marks an effect reaching and touching its object. The warning creates a threshold: end the saying before its consequence crosses into felt contact.

activation_trace.role: The reached endpoint supplies the stopping threshold offered by the conditional.
An effect reaching a person supplies the crossing from proposition to experienced consequence.
Painful punishment specifies the adverse effect that reaches the persisting speakers.
The pain-causing quality makes the threatened contact experiential rather than merely juridical.

changed_reading.before: A generic punishment is announced for a false belief.
changed_reading.after: A conditional interval remains in which the utterance can reach its end before its painful consequence reaches the persisting disbelievers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus demand to stop saying is surrounded by failures of learned authorities to prohibit sinful speech and of a community to prohibit one another from reprehensible action. Continued doctrine becomes a social inhibition failure, not only an individual's uncorrected opinion.

activation_trace.role: The doctrinal-saying image anchors the social mechanism to what the focus speakers continue to maintain.
Cessation is the focus ayah's required interruption of that maintained speech.
The failed act of restraining supplies institutional nonintervention as an enabling condition.
Sinful saying as a maintained position links the earlier leadership failure directly to speech.
Failure to restrain one another broadens the missing brake from leaders to reciprocal communal correction.
The reprehensible thing that should be repelled supplies the object and purpose of communal restraint.

structural_cues: 5:63 asks why religious authorities do not prohibit sinful saying.
5:79 repeats the reciprocal form: they did not prohibit one another from a reprehensible act.
5:73 places the same stopping root inside the consequence condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated prohibition failures around saying and wrongdoing; I infer that nonintervention enables the focus doctrine to persist. A live alternative is that 5:63 and 5:79 address other misconduct and only analogically illuminate 5:73.

changed_reading.before: Each speaker merely needs to revise a private doctrinal opinion.
changed_reading.after: The saying persists through a communal loop that leaders and peers fail to interrupt, so the command to desist also exposes a social duty of correction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent identification of Allah with the Messiah is named association; the next ayah locates the Messiah in human filiation and makes both him and his mother eat food, while the following ayah denies divine standing to what cannot control harm or benefit. These dependency tests revise the numerical baseline into a category test: dependent embodied beings cannot be constituent members of deity.

activation_trace.role: Third-as-completer anchors the proposed placement of a member inside the divine count.
Unity without partner or partition supplies the category boundary that the context tests.
Association with Allah explicitly names the operation that the focus's counted membership performs.
Sonship and attribution to an origin place the Messiah within human genealogy.
Eating supplies the recurring bodily act that marks creaturely dependence.
Taking and tasting food supplies the material object of that dependence.
Possession and power of disposal, here negated, supply a functional test for an object claimed as divine.

structural_cues: 5:72 contrasts the identification claim with the Messiah's command to worship Allah, his Lord and theirs.
5:75 states that the Messiah and his mother both ate food.
5:76 asks about worshipping what does not control harm or benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies association, human filiation, eating, and negated control; I infer that dependence disqualifies a proposed member from the divine category. Alternatively, these details may refute one specific identification without asserting a general doctrine of noncomposition.

changed_reading.before: The triadic claim fails only because its arithmetic total is wrong.
changed_reading.after: The triadic claim fails because it installs dependent embodied members inside deity, a category that the one deity cannot share or partition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that marks covering truth in the focus later names God's covering of misdeeds, and the immediate next ayah adds protective forgiveness. The warning therefore opens a reversible transition from culpable covering to restorative covering through cessation and repentance.

activation_trace.role: Covering or denying truth supplies the harmful state named at both ends of the focus ayah.
Cessation supplies the hinge by which the harmful covering can stop.
Covering misdeeds until their effect is removed reverses the root's direction from concealing truth to erasing fault.
Protective covering of sin and its effect supplies the offered destination immediately after the threat.

structural_cues: 5:65 conditions divine covering of misdeeds on belief and guarding.
5:73 conditions painful contact on failure to desist.
5:74 immediately asks whether they will repent and seek forgiveness, then names God forgiving and merciful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite covering branches and the immediate repentance invitation; I infer a directional path from truth-covering through cessation to sin-covering. Alternatively, the shared covering image may be lexical resonance rather than a deliberately staged reversal.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief is a fixed label followed by an unavoidable sentence.
changed_reading.after: The ayah names a harmful covering but leaves a conditional route into repentance and a restorative covering that protects from the threatened effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope's positive endpoint explicitly rewards hearers because of what they said. Return and recompense branches make speech accountable action. This mirrors the focus, where persisting in what is said carries a painful return; opposite utterances enact opposite alignments.

activation_trace.role: Saying as adopted belief anchors the focus consequence to a verbalized alignment rather than to noise alone.
The hearers' saying voices the opposite adopted stance, preparing the positive comparison.
Heart-settling affirmation supplies the content and inward alignment of their spoken response.
A result returning to the actor supplies the causal return assigned to their saying.
Uttered speech is explicitly named as the basis of the positive return.
Matching an act with its recompense generalizes the speech-to-consequence mechanism.

structural_cues: 5:83 records recognition followed by the utterance, Our Lord, we believe.
5:85 states that God rewarded them because of what they said.
5:73 likewise links failure to stop what is said with a specified consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit positive causal link from saying to returned reward; I infer a deliberate negative-positive symmetry with the focus warning. A live alternative is that 5:85 rewards the recognized faith behind the words, not the utterance considered independently.

changed_reading.before: Punishment answers an abstract proposition held in the mind.
changed_reading.after: Spoken doctrine is performative alignment: one saying continues truth-covering toward painful contact, while recognized truth voiced as belief receives a matched return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus restricts painful contact to the disbelievers among the speakers. Context repeatedly differentiates internal trajectories: a moderate community exists among them, and some who identify as Christians are near in affection, listen, recognize, and affirm belief. The subgroup marker is therefore operative rather than incidental.

activation_trace.role: Truth-covering supplies the behavior that qualifies the threatened subset, rather than functioning as an undifferentiated ancestry label.
Moderation between extremes supplies an explicit counter-trajectory within the larger group.
Nearness supplies relational contrast to the hostile or persisting subgroup.
Affection supplies the positive social disposition of a differently responding subgroup.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies receptivity rather than persistence in the condemned saying.
Recognition by a mark supplies a cognitive reversal from covering truth to identifying it.
Heart-settling affirmation supplies the resulting alternative status within the named population.

structural_cues: 5:73 says the disbelievers among them, grammatically restricting the threatened class.
5:66 contrasts an upright community among them with many who act badly.
5:82-83 identify a Christian-labeled subgroup whose humility, hearing, recognition, and believing move in the opposite direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated internal contrasts and the focus's منهم; I infer that the threat tracks persisting response rather than flattening every member of a named community. The alternative is that the pronoun's immediate antecedent is only the speakers, though even then it preserves a qualified subset.

changed_reading.before: The ayah condemns an entire religious population as one fixed block.
changed_reading.after: The ayah targets those among the speakers who persist in truth-covering, while the context preserves moderate, receptive, and believing trajectories within the broader population.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prohibition of excess in religion, beyond truth, followed by desire and repeated straying, supplies a production sequence for the focus saying. The triadic formula can be read as the verbal endpoint of boundary overrun, inherited attachment, and directional loss rather than as a detached arithmetic mistake.

activation_trace.role: Saying as a doctrinal position anchors the path mechanism to the focus proposition.
The third-member construction supplies the doctrinal endpoint produced by the path.
Religion as obedience and submission supplies the domain in which the boundary is overrun.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the boundary that excess leaves behind.
Following as allegiance and succession supplies the social transmission step.
The inclination of desire supplies the directional pull behind that following.
Repeated deviation from guidance supplies both prior path dependence and its multiplying effect.

structural_cues: 5:77 contains the branchless cue غ ل و as a direct prohibition of excess in religion.
The same ayah orders excess, truth, following desire, prior straying, causing many to stray, and renewed straying from the level path.
5:73 names the resulting counted proposition as something repeatedly said.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequenced excess-following-desire-straying chain; I infer that it causally generates and transmits the focus formula. Alternatively, 5:77 may diagnose a broader set of doctrines and practices rather than this saying alone.

changed_reading.before: Third of three is an isolated logical error.
changed_reading.after: Third of three is also the verbal product of religious boundary overrun, desire-led succession, and a path that reproduces deviation through followers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the third-hearthstone branch is a material idiom, not the ordinary propositional force of the phrase. It remains anchored directly to ث ل ث and is activated by the packet's immediate eating and food sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a translation or primary lexical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ثَالِثُ ثَلَاثَةٍ permits the branch image of a third stone completing a three-support hearth.

activation_trace.role: The third hearthstone supplies a concrete image of one support being installed beside two to hold a cooking vessel.
Eating activates the domestic support image while marking the human figures' dependence.
Food supplies the material around which the hearth image coheres.

changed_reading.before: The ordinal is only an abstract position in a theological count.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the claim installs Allah like a third support in a food-bearing human arrangement, sharpening the context's irony that the proposed human members themselves depend on eating.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because restraint is a distant branch of ع ذ ب while punishment is the direct local branch. It remains anchored to the focus's paired cessation and punishment roots and forms a clean reversal. Downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary word-image, not redefine عذاب as restraint.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Failure to يَنتَهُوا is followed by عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary cessation supplies the restraint the speakers refuse to enact.
Withholding, preventing, or weaning supplies an imposed-restraint image nested behind the punishment term.
Pain-causing force keeps the exploratory restraint image subordinate to the explicit punitive sense.

changed_reading.before: Refused cessation and punishment are unrelated stages.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, failure to accept voluntary restraint from the saying culminates in a painful form of imposed restraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and is therefore form-distant from ordinary saying. It remains anchored to both occurrences of the focus root and gains a visible mechanism from the repeated context image of numerical manyness. Downstream prose should call it a split-root resonance about circulation and instability, not assign قلة as the verse's lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا and يَقُولُونَ repeat the focus root around a compact counted formula.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of movement and lack of settledness supplies conceptual instability beneath the repeated saying.
Growth in number supplies the social amplification that can make an unsettled formula appear established.

changed_reading.before: Repeated saying implies a stable and settled doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repetition among many may amplify a conceptually unsettled formula; social persistence can conceal instability rather than resolve it.

strongest_changes: The numerical correction became a rejection of dependent members and partition within deity.
The demand to desist became a communal inhibition problem as well as an individual decision.
The warning became reversible through the pericope's competing images of truth-covering and restorative covering.
The explicit reward because of what responsive hearers said made the focus saying part of a matched speech-to-consequence structure.
The focus's among them became a decisive subgroup restriction in light of later moderate and receptive trajectories.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly converted a compact theological proposition into inspectable mechanisms: counted membership, embodied dependence, failed social restraint, competing coverings, matched returns for speech, and differentiated responses within a named population.
remaining_uncertainties: The indivisibility reading of one is branch-supported but may go beyond a narrower denial of partners.
The causal symmetry between the condemned saying and the rewarded saying may concern the dispositions voiced by speech rather than words independently.
The hearthstone, imposed-restraint, and split-root readings are live analogies but must remain explicitly exploratory.
